panels.headline: One Year of Partnership
panels.body: Your support keeps independent work personal, human, and close to home.
panels.art_direction: Cinematic single-object cover with clean white background and deep teal metallic accent. The sterilizer system is the hero composition with generous margins and a quiet central text-safe area for the app overlay.
panels.image_prompt: A premium 5x7 flat print panel artwork featuring a clean white sterilizer system on a light background with deep teal metallic accents and generous margins for a quiet central text-safe area. Flat 2D full-bleed digital illustration. No readable text. No words, letters, handwriting, calligraphy, labels, signatures, or fake text. No people. No hands. No logos. No watermark. Avoid all-over repeating wallpaper patterns; use restrained hierarchy and negative space. No caption plaque, no text box, no inner card rectangle, no blank tag, no label. Not a photo, not a physical paper card, not a folded card mockup, not a tabletop scene, not a product photograph.

panels.body: You chose an independent small business when there were easier, bigger options. That choice matters, and it helps keep the care, craft, and human side of this work alive.
